purpose: Factorial data coverage and kinematic architecture study
sampling: Sequence-balanced with replacement, same total updates for every model
small: Existing v4 train_cache excluding subjects003/020 and camera4
expanded: Exact small subset union new fit complete clips; new clips containing any duplicate sample IDs are excluded
tune: Only new subjects003/020 camera4, entire subjects/camera absent from both fit budgets
loss: Same FP32 head-relative body+3xsole geometry, normalized head and .01 parameter loss as neural-v1
selection: Train-only choose best nonzero checkpoint by normalized mean raw+aligned body+sole; then choose strength0/.25/.5/1 with all four mean errors <=1.01 baseline; identity fallback
stop_rule: If expansion and kinematic model do not stably improve heldout soles across seeds, stop this global-query residual family; do not widen the gate
